33286.name: PITAKA Iphone 17 Pro Edge Case (PTK Leaping-Orange Black)

bullets.title: The Inspiration of a Thread
bullets.text: PITAKA's story begins with a thread of aramid fiber, a line that symbolizes our ongoing spirit of self-reflection and reinvention, reminding us to sweep away distractions and embrace purity. Inspired by this thread, we reimagined PITAKA's logo, turning it's initials into an artistic monogram design. It's our tribute to those bold enough to erase impurities and refine themselves.

bullets.title: Text Weaving to New Heights
bullets.text: Through the intricate interlacing of lightweight yet durable aramid fibers, the woven text on the case offers a unique and classic aesthetic while revealing refined textures that provide a delightful tactile experience.

bullets.title: PitaTap™
bullets.text: A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control Button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. Seamlessly integrated, it preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.

bullets.title: Find Your Stride
bullets.text: Discover the elegance of your own pace through our rhythmic, woven design. A refined companion that captures the beauty of moving forward with confidence and grace.

bullets.title: Amber
bullets.text: Vibrant orange tones bring the woven pattern to life, capturing motion, passion, and drive.Made for those who stay true to themselves, advancing step by step with confidence and momentum.Find Your Stride. Stay True. Move with Confidence.

bullets.title: Triple-layer Fusion Weaving in Happiness Rides In
bullets.text: The galloping horse comes to life on the case, offering a tactile feel that is refined, subtle, and layered.Interwoven yarns add visual depth and richer color while keeping the case slim and lightweight, resulting in a weave that feels more precise, balanced, and detailed.Understated in appearance, yet satisfying to the touch.
Find your stride, and move forward at your own pace. Stay true to who you are and rise with quiet confidence.
